description: This file defines the CsrfRequestHeaderAccessCheck class, which implements CSRF attack protection by checking request headers for CSRF tokens and validating them, specifically for routes requiring CSRF protection within Drupal.

classes.name: CsrfRequestHeaderAccessCheck
classes.description: A class implementing access checks against CSRF attacks by validating CSRF tokens in request headers for protected routes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes session configuration and CSRF token generator.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Determines if the CSRF check applies to a given route based on route requirements and HTTP methods.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Performs the CSRF token validation for a request, allowing read-only methods and validating tokens for write methods.
